title: fix(server): name a flow the gate cannot read instead of calling it deleted

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+### Fixed
+
+- **`@reticlehq/server` — `reticle gate` reported a flow it could not read as deleted coverage.** A CLI older than the daemon that saved the flows left them out with no message, then failed with `deletedCoverage` for files that exist. The gate now lists them under `unreadableFlows` with the parse error, names `reticle update` for a flow of a newer format, and still fails. Closes [#2477](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/issues/2477).

@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@ In hook mode only, setting `RETICLE_SKIP_GATE` turns a failing gate into exit `0
 | `uncovered` | Yes | An affected flow with no passing artifact |
 | `downgraded` | Yes | A flow whose assertions were weakened since its last passing run. A green bought by weakening the test is the gaming move this exists to stop |
 | `deletedCoverage` | Yes | A flow that covered a changed file and has since vanished. Coverage deleted, not satisfied |
+| `unreadableFlows` | Yes | A flow file that is on disk and that this CLI could not read, with the parse error. It is not counted as deleted. A flow of a newer format needs `reticle update` |
 | `unflowed` | Yes | A changed interactive component that no saved flow drives. Only once the project has saved flows, so a first day never blocks |
 | `coverageRegressed` | Yes | A [coverage](/capabilities) level fell below the best it has reached: something new appeared that nothing covers. Cover it, or accept the drop with `--accept-coverage` |
 | `unexecuted` | Yes | A changed file the browser loaded during a drive and never ran a function of |
@@ -49,7 +50,7 @@ One `reticle_gate` line. Real capture from this repository, with the flow lists
 }
 ```
 
-`downgraded`, `deletedCoverage`, `unflowed`, `coverageRegressed`, `unexecuted`, `coverageStale` and `coverageAccepted` appear only when they are non-empty, `flowsWithoutSources` only when it is `true`, and none was present in that run. The coverage categories need a coverage ledger, which a project gets from `reticle_verify { action: "crawl", exhaustive: true }` or `reticle_verify { action: "coverage", app: true }`; without one they never fire. The CLI prints this as a single line of JSON; it is pretty-printed here to be readable.
